title: Tic-Tac-Toe on an N×N Board
summary: Game state, turn order, O(1) win detection with counters, and draw handling. A favourite warm-up at Microsoft and Amazon.
hints: Keep counters instead of scanning the board: `rows[n]`, `cols[n]`, `diag` and `anti`. Add +1 for X and −1 for O. A player wins when any counter reaches ±n.
A move at (r, c) touches `rows[r]`, `cols[c]`, `diag` when `r == c`, and `anti` when `r + c == n - 1`.
The game status is an enum: `IN_PROGRESS`, `X_WON`, `O_WON` or `DRAW`. No moves are accepted after the game is over.
Validate in this order: game over, then out of bounds, then cell taken, then wrong player's turn.
